description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Null Maiden Vigil — SILENT SISTERHOOD (WP-C46): friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD units have BATTLELINE; friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units have CREEPING DREAD (Aura): in the Battle-shock step of the opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of the unit that is a PSYKER unit / below starting strength makes a battle-shock roll at -1. Fixture ork11e_o34_active (P1 Orks active, Command phase; P2 Custodes with the Prosecutor Squad, ANATHEMA PSYKANA); setup privileges: P2 detachment Null Maiden Vigil (keyword grants applied), CP 0 for both, one Tankbusta removed (below starting strength, ~6" from the Prosecutors), then the Command phase is re-entered (the real phase entry builds the battle-shock queue). The Prosecutors carry BATTLELINE; the Tankbustas are queued for a battle-shock test with reason Creeping Dread; a real click on RESOLVE BATTLE-SHOCK starts the step (the windows not under test are declined) and the roll card for the Tankbustas names Creeping Dread and its -1; a real click on Roll resolves it with the -1 applied.

steps.comment: setup privileges (see description); the Prosecutor Squad gains BATTLELINE
steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["2"]["detachment"] = "Null Maiden Vigil"
var D = load("res://scripts/codex/custodes/CustodesDetachments.gd")
D.apply_keyword_grants(2)
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
var tb = GameState.state.units["U_TANKBUSTAS_A"].models[0]
tb["alive"] = false
tb["current_wounds"] = 0
tree.current_scene._recreate_unit_visuals()
return "BATTLELINE" in GameState.state.units["U_PROSECUTORS_A"].meta.keywords

steps.comment: the Tankbustas owe a battle-shock test because of Creeping Dread, at -1
starting the roll call starts the Battle-shock step
the Battle-shock-step windows are not under test — declined
advance the roll call to the Tankbustas' card (other units' tests are rolled with real clicks first)
the roll was resolved with the -1 applied
